description_en: Attaches tags to one or more resources
description_zh: 为一个或多个资源打标签
kebab_example: aliyun composer tag-resources --resource-type ALIYUN::LC::FLOW --resource-id lc-uf6abcdefg --tag Value=tagValue Key=tagKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.description_en:
The type of the resources. Set the value to ALIYUN::LC::FLOW.

*   ALIYUN::LC::FLOW indicates Logic Composer workflows.
parameters.description_zh:
资源类型，可取的值有：

- ALIYUN::LC::FLOW：逻辑编排工作流
